title: Assessment of clozapine-related immunodeficiency effect in Parkinson's disease patients (CLOZIDPD)
official: Assessment of clozapine-related immunodeficiency effect in Parkinson's disease patients (CLOZIDPD)
summary: Main objective: to evaluate the variation in the serum IgG level reflecting the humoral immune response 6 months after the initiation of treatment with Clozapine.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patient ≥ 18 years old with Parkinson's disease
2. Psychotic symptoms requiring initiation of treatment with Clozapine
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with a contraindication to the use of Clozapine according to the summary of product characteristics (SPC)
2. Patient with another potential cause of immunosuppression
3. Patient with potentially major cognitive disorders defined by a MoCA score less than or equal to 23

sites.f: Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Amiens Picardie – Neurologie
